column7: ScopeLens: compare a project brief against up to three vendor proposals
Adversarial algorithmic-trading research lab: deterministic walk-forward backtests on synthetic data, sealed holdouts, GitHub-native state, honest rejections. No live trading.

Brand brief to website: contrast-checked tokens, type and spacing scales, Web Animations motion, three-width preview and a dependency-free export that builds byte-identical to the preview. Deterministic; AI-proposed briefs are owner-only.
Offline cloud-security configuration review: Bash and PowerShell adapters, OPA/Rego findings cited to source lines, expiring exceptions, verified remediation patches. Synthetic data only.

Replayable security-log investigation: synthetic append-only batches, correlation rules, evidence-linked incident timelines, hypotheses with alternatives, gaps that lower confidence. Synthetic data only.
Self-repairing data pipeline workbench: contracts, drift repair with evidence, quarantine with reasons, row reconciliation and lineage on synthetic order batches.
Tactile turntable portfolio edition of Rishit Raj Mathur (static HTML/CSS/JS, drawn in code)

Four art-directed private editions of Rishit Raj Mathur's portfolio (Signal Studio, Architect's Table, Flight Recorder, The Current): one repo, shared content and behaviour, four protected deployments.
Live read-only snapshot of the trading bot dashboard (auto-updated)
Rishit's analyst projects, each with a step-by-step build log
MarginPilot: AI FinOps and cloud profitability intelligence (synthetic demo data)
Eleven independently runnable CRM MVPs (private)
Eleven static showcase sites for eleven original CRM applications (the applications are private and not hosted)
OMNIVERSE: history-remediated private copy (staging source). Original mrrishit909/omniverse retained as rollback.
Decision Universe: every decision creates a different future. Seeded Monte Carlo, Bayes, forecasts, LP and causal inference, checked against a Python reference in the browser.
Retail Intelligence Studio: one gift-ware wholesaler's ledger as pairs of discs of light whose overlap is exactly what two sets share.
Healthscape: CDC PLACES model-based health estimates for 3,144 counties as one disc of light, with the missing counties left missing.
The Supply Chain Orchestra: a synthetic-cost network design on real Census city anchors, solved with HiGHS in Python and in your browser.
Sentinel Anomaly Lab: five anomaly detectors benchmarked on labelled simulated telemetry (CATS v2), scored by event, not by point.
Economic Atlas: a scroll story and comparison engine over World Bank data for 217 countries, drawn as a seed head of one-million-person grains.
Pulse: The Energy Grid. Hourly US grid data, forecast benchmark and an in-browser 24-hour dispatch model.
Climate Signal Observatory: a scroll-driven data story of GISTEMP and HadCRUT5 temperature anomalies, rebuilt from the grid cells. Offline Python pipeline, static site, honesty-tagged.
Atlas of Human Mobility: a scroll-driven data story of 280 million 2024 New York for-hire trips, with a labeled BPR scenario lab and full honesty tags.
Grab Our Deals: Next.js/Prisma storefront, trade-in, wholesale, auctions (private)

An electrical grid, reconstructed under computed flow constraints. Interactive, island-aware DC-OPF visualization of the IEEE case30 network -- browser-side LP solve, GSAP cinematic choreography, independently verified against a Python oracle.
An interactive cinematic city exploring counterfactual outcomes through causal inference, synthetic control, and data-driven visual storytelling.
One income prediction, placed on trial: real logistic-model attributions, counterfactuals, threshold and calibration over a persistent WebGL evidence chamber.
Real retail BI: a copper ribbon of 24 months of real net revenue that coils into a 12-spoke dial for year-over-year comps
Secure natural-language-to-SQL: Claude proposes SQL, sqlglot AST validator + read-only DB enforce it
Telecom churn prediction lab: real scikit-learn model, FastAPI, React, SHAP explainability
Motorsport telemetry and vehicle dynamics experience, built with Blender and three.js (Advanced Engineering Build Book Vol VIII)
Digital art conservation and restoration laboratory: one seven-modality shader, a comparison lens, navigation labels living in the conservation frame
Wildfire behavior and community risk digital twin: one wind-elongated perimeter formula drives the terrain shader, tree char state and structure risk together
Interactive optical systems and light design laboratory: six real optics formulas, no boxed panels, light itself is the interface
Paper-trading bot on Alpaca: moving-average strategy, a risk engine every order must pass, a SQLite decision log, and a Claude advisor (no real money)
Stadium crowd flow and evacuation intelligence platform: one instanced crowd reads as a flow field at distance and individuals up close, gate closure redistributes flow live
Digital couture and material physics atelier: one shader-driven garment mesh carries Thread through Runway, fabric swatches change drape physics
Virtual film production and previsualization studio: shot-driven camera with real lens FOV and circle-of-confusion math
Semiconductor chip architecture, thermal and yield intelligence platform: one zoom value carries the camera from wafer to atomic lattice with live thermal/power/yield overlays
Interactive fusion reactor operations and plasma education platform: single reactor-state value drives HUD, 16 instanced field coils and a GLSL plasma shader through 8 stages
Seismic risk and subsurface infrastructure digital twin: Blender-scripted infrastructure shaft and building kit, synthetic fault rupture with attenuation and cascading utility failure, three.js
ARBOR: a urban tree canopy planner. Grow, shade, plant and optimise on a synthetic district; simplified model, not for real planning.
POLARIS: a polar expedition planner. A crack becomes the route under the aurora; synthetic ice, weather and telemetry, not for navigation.
ALCHEMIA: a materials library you can break. Weighted constellation, virtual tensile, bending and impact tests; synthetic records, not datasheets.
SONORA: a spatial music venue and acoustic designer. A sound wave reveals the hall; simplified acoustic prediction on synthetic data.
KINTSUGI: a product lifecycle passport. A kettle shatters, repairs in gold, and carries its history (synthetic data).
Exoplanet discovery lab on synthetic worlds: transits, spectra and habitability with a scripted Blender planet set and tested science. Synthetic data.
Digital museum demo for a fictional endangered building: a scripted Blender model with time-driven erosion, an anchored archive and a conservation plan. Fictional data.
Watch configurator demo: a scripted Blender watch and movement, exploded view, material lab, complications, engraving and commission summary. Fictional brand, synthetic prices.
Soil intelligence demo for a fictional regenerative farm: a Blender cutaway, strands generated from guide curves, water, carbon and rotation models. Synthetic data.
Deep-ocean exploration demo: a Blender-built submersible, a scripted asset pipeline and a descent that hands off to a working mission control. Synthetic data.

AETHER: multi-agent airport disruption recovery. A weather agent, four parallel analysts, a real gate solver and a synthesizer; split-view plan comparison and a dispatcher approval gate. Synthetic data, simulated models.
Multi-agent cyber incident investigation command center: tiered model routing, simulated providers, red-team review, motion topology (synthetic data)

HELIX: a research-only multi-agent precision-medicine workspace on a synthetic corpus: parallel agents, a critic that catches contradictions, claims that open to their source evidence (TypeScript, Next.js, three.js, Fastify, Postgres)

ATLAS: multi-agent real-estate development intelligence on a synthetic city: parallel due-diligence agents, spreadsheet-parity zoning and pro forma calculators, morphing massing, and an investment committee that challenges its own assumptions (Volume VI, blueprint 03)
ORBITAL: motion-first space-traffic sandbox. SGP4 in the browser, conjunction screening, collision probability, avoidance burns with re-screening (synthetic data)
FORGE: motion-first industrial digital-twin builder. Snapping editor, MQTT telemetry bindings, branch-and-simulate with confidence intervals, collaboration (synthetic data)
CHRONOS: a motion-first time machine for 12,000 years. Cited facts, illustrative borders, published city estimates, synchronised comparisons and stories
QUANTUM: visual quantum circuit lab. Bloch spheres and entanglement from the live state, Rust/WASM simulator, noise, mock hardware (simulated)
ECHO: motion-first music sampling graph. Synthetic catalogue, audio fingerprinting, sample lineage, genre communities, scene map
NEXUS: motion-first infrastructure dependency map. Cascading failure, capacity-aware rerouting, Monte Carlo resilience and remediation (synthetic network)
PULSE: live-style map of synthetic trade flows, port congestion and a regional activity nowcast that reads 77 days ahead of the official figure (synthetic data)
GENESIS: motion-first tree of life through 4.5 billion years. Cited clades and extinctions, synthetic fossils, K-Pg collapse, museum mode
TERRA: motion-first climate digital twin. Scroll from orbit, scrub 1950-2100, dive to a coastal city, compare present and future (synthetic data)
SYNAPSE: visual, observable agent workflow builder. Canvas with live execution traces, retries and fallbacks, provider swap, evaluation and a release gate (simulated providers)
Through the Storm, or Around It? Volume IV blueprint 9, a vertical slice on synthetic data.
Multi-agent decision lab: a subscription business as calibrated agents, 10,000 seeded scenarios of a price rise, bit-for-bit replay, Sobol sensitivity, four-eyes decisions
Virtual power plant for 10,000 home devices: availability learned from telemetry, a bid sized to it, feeder-safe dispatch, edge fallback, and settlement scored against the simulation truth
Thermal model fitted to a simulated hall's sensors, thermal-aware GPU placement (MILP), set-point LP, and a CRAC-failure closed loop with approved power caps
Fisheries monitoring on a simulated sea: which AIS silences were on purpose, who a dark radar target could be, carrier meetings, an explainable risk ranking, scored against the truth

Product recall scoping from imperfect shop-floor records: probabilistic genealogy, the cheapest defensible recall set, scored against simulation truth

Hurricane catastrophe model for a synthetic coastal insurer: climate fitted to forty years of tracks, censored damage-curve fit to claims, 50,000-event catalogue, PML with sampling interval, Cat 4 stress test, four-eyes sign-off, all judged against the hidden truth
Patch memory-bank defect detection on a simulated 30 FPS line: operator review, few-shot retraining, canary deploy, all scored against the truth

Grocery fresh-department optimizer: demand read through stockouts, shelf life from lot temperature logs, markdowns by dynamic programming, heatwave replenishment, every decision scored against a simulator's hidden truth
Prior-art search by claim element on a synthetic battery-pack patent corpus: BM25 + LSA with element re-ranking, evidence matrix, white space, judged against hidden concepts

Predict each Texas bar's next-month liquor receipts from the Comptroller's mixed beverage tax data: R, time-aware validation, COVID break, survivorship

Do critics' scores predict film audiences and box office? 607 Wikipedia film articles (MediaWiki API) joined to IMDb's official ratings: parse rates, critics vs audiences, box office, selection, regression to the mean

Who leaves the US federal workforce, and when? OPM separations 2016-2025 and FEVS agency link, recounted in plain Python

Which items do shoppers click, cart and buy next? Hand-written session recommenders (popularity, category, co-visits, seen items) on Retailrocket events, scored on clicks, carts and orders with a blended score, evaluation traps, and a plain-Python recompute
Who does data work in the Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2024-2025, what do they use, and are they paid more? Aggregates only, with a plain-Python recount.
How far simple methods (lexicon, naive Bayes, TF-IDF + logistic regression) read 130k Amazon music reviews: baseline, splits, leakage, 3-star labels, calibration; plain-Python recount
Eight restaurant stocks against the S&P 500: performance, drawdowns, the 2020 shock, correlation, beta and a momentum test with bootstrap uncertainty

Walmart's M5 sales data (3,049 items, 10 stores, 5.3 years) analysed entirely in SQL with DuckDB: revenue, SNAP days, events, prices, zero-sale days, Pareto concentration; plain-Python recount of 2,151 numbers
Stylised facts of stock returns: fat tails, volatility clustering, leverage, GARCH vs constant, and trend failure for 10 large stocks and SPY

Hourly NYC taxi pickups 2022-2026: how well simple anomaly detectors (rolling z, seasonal z, IQR, isolation forest) find labelled holidays, marathons, snowstorms and heavy rain, and how much the threshold matters

Can Wikipedia page views predict next year's peak? Seasonality, weekday effects, spike half-lives, walk-forward peak forecasts and topic displacement for 12 Wikipedia topics, 2016-2026 (Wikimedia Pageviews API, CC0)

Does ARIMA beat 'same month last year'? Walk-forward test of SARIMA, ETS and benchmarks on US Census monthly sales of furniture stores and of office supplies, stationery and gift stores, with interval coverage and the COVID break
How accurately can a used car's price be predicted? Craigslist listings (OpenML 43306, CC0), grouped CV, depreciation, intervals, plain-Python recount
Did guest stars lift The Office's IMDb ratings? A season-adjusted permutation test on 188 episodes, plus Netflix catalogue running times, ages, countries and genres, with a plain-Python recount

What makes a Hacker News story reach 100 points? 703,300 stories from 27 sampled months through the public HN Search API: heavy tail, hour/weekday/kind/title/domain, a live points probe and a time-aware model with leakage traps (Python).
Crowdsourced Open Prices shelf prices: how far apart one barcode's price is across shops, how much is the shop and the pack size, and what traps the file holds

How fairly do votes become seats in India? First-past-the-post arithmetic of 16 Lok Sabha elections 1962-2024: seat bonus, Gallagher index, effective number of parties, margins, NOTA, women (Python, plain-Python recount)

Where Bengaluru's food places cluster: OpenStreetMap restaurants, cafes and fast food through the Overpass API, density rings, nearest-neighbour and Ripley's K against simulated random points, cuisine, chains, tag completeness, with a plain-Python recount
Did Super Bowl ad prices outrun the audience? R analysis of viewership, ad prices in 2025 dollars, halftime shows and the ads of 2000-2020 with YouTube views; plain-Python recount of every number
Do five companies hold half the unicorn value? SQL (DuckDB) analysis of Wikipedia's list of unicorn startups at three dates: concentration, industries, stale valuations, survivorship
How far ahead can world food prices be forecast? Rolling-origin forecasts of the FAO Food Price Index, pass-through to US food prices, and what the index adds to a US food inflation forecast
What moves the price of gold? Real yields, the dollar, inflation expectations and fear against the World Bank monthly gold price, with a Chow test and out-of-sample forecasts
How far ahead does today's weather beat the calendar? Walk-forward forecasts of temperature and rain at twelve US airport stations (NOAA GHCN-Daily)
What makes some US states deadlier to drive in? NHTSA FARS 2023-2024 deaths against FHWA vehicle-miles: geography, regression, clustering
Who are the influencers in a Twitter network? Followers, PageRank, betweenness, communities and attacks on a 2012 crawl of 81,306 accounts (SNAP)
Would you notice when a fraud model breaks? Monitors, alarms and retraining on 203,769 real Bitcoin transactions (Elliptic)

What predicts a car insurance claim? 678,013 French motor policies (OpenML freMTPL2freq, CC0): a Poisson model with exposure against the naive logistic model, tested out of fold with folds made of covariate profiles; every fit proved by its score equations in plain Python

Does any recommender beat 'most popular'? Four recommenders on MovieLens 1M, tested by hiding one rating per user two ways: hit rate, who is helped, how few movies fill the slots; recomputed in plain Python (numpy only for the SVD)

When and where does New York take an Uber? 4.5 million pickups of 2014 and 14.3 million of 2015 from FiveThirtyEight's TLC public-records files: weekday and hour, map, borough and zone, counted twice in plain Python

What makes an Austin Airbnb expensive? Inside Airbnb listings of June 2026: size, type, place, host and amenities scored out of sample with folds made of hosts, least squares against boosted trees, recomputed in plain Python

What does a night in New York cost on Airbnb? Five Inside Airbnb files in three formats, cleaned, combined and checked against each other: minimum stays, price quotes and registration, recomputed in plain Python

Can anyone forecast Bitcoin? Walk-forward tests on 3,065 days of Bitcoin and Ether from the Coin Metrics community data, 2018 to 2026: returns, volatility and value at risk, recomputed in plain Python

How much of the tracked crypto market is Bitcoin? Month-end market values from the Coin Metrics community data, 2013 to 2026, cleaned of double counting; shares, concentration and a year of change, recomputed from the raw table

How many more people died than the official COVID-19 count says? World Mortality Dataset and JHU counts for 105 countries, 2020 to 2022: excess deaths with prediction intervals, recomputed from the raw files
How fast did COVID-19 spread in its first 100 days? JHU CSSE confirmed cases in R: log-scale growth, doubling times for the world and for each country after 100 cases, recomputed in plain Python

When does the air turn unhealthy? EPA AirData daily AQI for 609 US counties, 2015 to 2025: bad days by year, month, pollutant and county, plus an interactive year-by-day explorer; recomputed from the raw files
Is the world's warming speeding up? NASA GISTEMP and NOAA Mauna Loa CO2: trends with Newey-West errors, a quadratic acceleration test across windows, recomputed by hand

When will the world's population peak? UN World Population Prospects 2024: scenarios and prediction intervals, shrinking countries, peak years, density; recomputed from the raw files (CC BY 3.0 IGO data)
Fisher's 150 iris flowers: how far do one measurement, Fisher's discriminant and four other models go? Learning curve, hard flowers, hand-fitted recompute (UCI data)
690 credit card applications: can a model beat one column? Six contenders, corrected intervals, hand-fitted recompute (UCI data)

Who buys online? 12,330 shopping sessions (UCI): new visitors buy 25% vs 14%, the gap survives adjustment; a purchase model drops from AUC 0.93 to 0.78 without the leaky PageValues; 136 numbers recomputed by hand

What is Moby-Dick made of? 213,516 words from Project Gutenberg: vocabulary, Zipf and Heaps laws, whale density by chapter, where each name falls; 1,527 numbers recounted with a character scanner

How much of London's travel has come back? 16 years of TfL journeys by mode in SQL (DuckDB): mode share, pandemic recovery, seasons, robust anomalies, and the table's own errors; 1,596 numbers recomputed without SQL

Which NYC schools post the top SAT scores? 2012 results for 421 schools cleaned and joined to school poverty: rankings, boroughs (plain vs weighted), poverty explains 52%; 126 numbers recomputed from raw downloads
Who do developing countries owe? World Bank debt statistics for 120 countries 2000-2024 in SQL (DuckDB): borrowers, lenders (bondholders 46%), China, debt service; 841 numbers recomputed without SQL
Which kidney-stone treatment works better? Simpson's paradox in R on 700 patients and Berkeley 1973 admissions: Mantel-Haenszel, logistic, standardised rates; 192 numbers recomputed in Python
What wins an IPL match? 1,243 matches ball by ball 2008-2026: toss is a coin flip, safe total up ~25 runs since 2023, a chase win-probability model with walk-forward test; hand-fitted recompute
Do women's World Cup matches have more goals? 752 matches since 2002, three tests over six windows: p runs 0.004 to 0.083 by which tournaments are in; leave-one-out, bootstrap, hand-built recompute
Who wins the Nobel Prize? All 1,026 prizes 1901-2025 from the official API: US birthplace vs workplace, women, age, shared prizes, plain-Python recount
